Here are four different 2D platform fighting games that are best enjoyed with a group of friends. All of these games have local play and everything except Towerfall has online modes. I’ve recorded gameplay from Cobalt and Duck Game so I’m including those videos from my channel.

Please leave a comment suggesting other similar games and what you think of these ones.

#[Brawlhalla](http://store.steampowered.com/app/291550)

>Brawlhalla is a 2D platform fighter and 100% Free to Play. An eternal battle arena where the greatest Legends ever brawl to prove who is the best that ever was, is, or will be. Every match is an epic test of skill, speed, and strength, and every victory brings glory and bragging rights to the winner.

Brawlhalla is still in early access but already very popular. Controls are fluid and the fighting feels fair. Game is actively being developed and future updates promise more characters and maps.

# [Cobalt](http://store.steampowered.com/app/357340)

> Forget everything you’ve learned about combat. Cobalt’s slo-mo mechanic lets you perform moves that other games can’t comprehend. Discover the secrets of a distant colony in a cosmic campaign, take on challenges and rule the leaderboards, or face off against others in local and online multiplayer.

Cobalt has been around for a few years now as an alpha. It was released this year but Mojang totally dropped the ball. Server browser is a ghost town but there is are active players still around. Your best choice is to play this game with a bunch of friends or add the active people on your friends list so it is easier to organize matches. You can also customize all the weapon loadouts and character types. Comes with a map editor for making your own levels.

Lag ruins this game immediately. Playing with people outside of your region can be a nightmare.

[Gameplay]( https://youtu.be/WF3YK3KU4no)

#[Duck Game](http://store.steampowered.com/app/312530)

>Enter the futuristic year of 1984, an age where ducks run wild in a frantic battle for glory. Blast your friends with Shotguns, Net Guns, Mind Control Rays, Saxophones, Magnet Guns, and much, much more. This is DUCK GAME. Don't blink.

The game feels like Warioware and other crazy party games. One fight usually doesn’t last too long since one hit kills you if you’re not wearing armor. There is a lot of variety in the weapons and almost all of them are fun to use. After there are no survivors (more common than you think) or one winner, the game switches to the next map. You can dodge bullets by sliding or jumping. Items like crates and desks can block bullets and be used to crush players and barricade doors. No weapon customization but has a level editor. [Gameplay]( https://youtu.be/v7h9_Q5FTAE)

# [Towerfall: Ascension](http://store.steampowered.com/app/251470)

>TowerFall Ascension is the definitive version of the hit archery combat game. Inspired by classics from the golden age of couch multiplayer, it's a 4-player local party game centering around hilarious, intense versus matches. The core mechanics are simple and accessible, but hard to master and combat is fierce.

You are equipped with only a bow. One hit kills you but you can dash to dodge dodge or catch the arrows. Power ups appear in the map, giving you different types of arrows. You can also play it in coop with a friend against AI controlled monsters.
Here are my recommendations if you're craving for some 2D platform brawlers (Brawlhalla, Cobalt, Duck game, Towerfall: Ascension)
